scores.question: What weight capacity and frame durability do you need for safe home workouts?

scores.question: How easy is this equipment to assemble and install in a home gym environment?
scores.label: Missing / Not Addressed
scores.intentEnhancement: Add a bullet: '[Easy Assembly — No Wall Mount Required] Freestanding power tower sets up in minutes. Anti-scratch feet protect floors while providing rock-solid stability. No drilling or mounting hardware needed.'

gaps: No weight capacity mentioned — critical for durability-conscious buyers
No assembly/installation information — buyers need to know if wall-mount or freestanding, difficulty level
recommendations: Add weight capacity to Bullet 2 (e.g., 'supports 300+ lbs')
Add assembly/ease-of-setup bullet to address installation concern
Include floor protection claim (anti-scratch feet) in Bullet 5
Consider adding warranty claim for premium price point ($135.99)
